identity.name: IPIP 50-item Big-Five Factor Markers
identity.selected_form: Official 50-item sample questionnaire with five 10-item scales
identity.counting: One inventory, not five instruments or separate language instruments.
identity.audience: Adult self-report research first-review scope; no child validation claim.
identity.standardization_note: Official site explicitly says no mandatory item order or standardized administration. This package pins the published sample order/anchors for reproducibility, not claims a universal required order.

originalPapersLinkOnly.access: 17-page author-hosted scan detected; searchable primary abstract confirms adjective markers. Not claimed exact IPIP50 original item publication.

originalPapersLinkOnly.citation: Goldberg LR (1999). A broad-bandwidth, public-domain, personality inventory measuring the lower-level facets of several five-factor models. In Mervielde et al., Personality psychology in Europe 7:7–28. Tilburg University Press.
originalPapersLinkOnly.doi_status: No DOI verified; do not invent.
originalPapersLinkOnly.access: Official22-page full chapter retrieved for temporary reading; scanned PDF OCR verified title/copyright, pp10–11 origin/methods and p28 anchors. Chapter develops broad preliminary facet scales, not evidence that these exact50 sample items were first printed there.
originalPapersLinkOnly.rights: Chapter copyright distinct from IPIP items; link only, no archive permission established.
originalPapersLinkOnly.method_summary: Early IPIP drew on Dutch sentence items plus newly written English items;1252-item pool administered in parts to an adult Eugene–Springfield community sample. Footnote describes initial approximate1000 adults aged18–85. Five-point accuracy anchors appear in appendix. This history is not a norm or validation of the new Chinese draft.
originalPapersLinkOnly.temporary_copy_policy: Temporary reading/OCR only, outside deliverable; not uploaded or redistributed.

chineseValidationEvidence.citation: Zheng L et al. (2008). Reliability and concurrent validation of the IPIP Big-Five factor markers in China. Personality and Individual Differences45:649–654.
chineseValidationEvidence.population: Internet-recruited Chinese samples,633 heterosexual and437 homosexual participants; total1070;100items administered,50subset analyzed. These sample strata are literature context only, not requested respondent fields or inferable traits.
chineseValidationEvidence.provenance: Methods p650 identifies Xian Xu translation/backtranslation. Not validation of new AI draft or Jhu version.
chineseValidationEvidence.reliability_caution: Narrative p652 reports short Agreeableness alpha .69/.66 and other short scales .76–.87. Extracted Table1 duplicates long/short columns and conflicts with narrative: do not ingest table numeric values pending visual primary verification.
chineseValidationEvidence.norms: No study means or sexual-orientation comparisons imported as platform norms, profiling rules or individual classification.

thresholds.policy: No low/medium/high thresholds, desirable direction, diagnosis, types or ranking approved. Higher scores reflect more of the named tendency, not better people.
